reviewSamples.author: Courtney Sanon
reviewSamples.text: Caleb is the GOAT of auto detailing in Clearwater Beach and the surrounding areas! He is incredibly professional. The convenience of the mobility he provides is amazing. He came right over to give a free, precise quote beforehand so all the details were clear.

reviewSamples.author: Melissa Lewis
reviewSamples.text: Caleb did such an INCREDIBLE job transforming my minivan. I think it may have looked even better than when we purchased it. A week later, and it still smells fresh and just cleaned! Caleb also has such good people skills, and truly cares for his customers. I highly recommend. He is trustworthy and gives intense attention to detail.

reviewSamples.author: Kristine Ledford
reviewSamples.text: Highly HIGHLY recommend! Detailed my VERY old 2010 Ford Escape and somehow made it look brand new again. I have a 140-pound dog who rides with me everywhere and slobbers all over the car, so this was no small task! I honestly couldn't believe the results.

reviewSamples.author: Elisabeth Joyce
reviewSamples.text: Caleb helped us get our RV back to factory clean! He was extremely helpful, professional, and hardworking. The before and after photos are incredible, we hardly noticed how dirty it had gotten before, but after its like night and day!

reviewSamples.author: foreigntyler
reviewSamples.text: Caleb did an amazing job detailing my grandfather's truck! He came right to us, which made everything so convenient. He was professional, friendly, and did an incredible job making the truck look like it came fresh off the assembly line.

services_note: No se encontro lista de precios publicada (sin website, sin Instagram/Facebook, sin posts de Google Business con menu).
